title: App shell: screen registry, fixed navigation tabs, project tab bar with agent tabs and "+", liquid-glass components from the tokens
story: Grillo now opens in a liquid-glass window with a title bar and a tab bar: Setup, Project, Map, Tickets, PRD, one tab per running agent with an orange waiting-for-you dot, and "+". Each tab opens its screen, and a screen whose story has not landed yet says it is not built yet. Before this, the window was an empty backdrop.

checks.criterion: Fixed navigation as the prototype shows
checks.steps: Run npm run dev with GRILLO_STORE=memory.
checks.expected: A frosted glass window, the title bar "Grillo Setup", and the tabs Setup, Project, Map, Tickets, PRD and "+", with Setup active and "Setup is not built yet."

checks.criterion: Each fixed tab opens its screen
checks.steps: Click Map, then Tickets, then PRD, then Project.
checks.expected: The clicked tab raised and active, the title bar showing its name, and "<name> is not built yet." until that screen's story lands.

checks.criterion: Agent tabs come from the runtime, with their title and waiting dot
checks.steps: In the developer tools console run window.grillo.invoke('agents:start', {kind:'grilling', folder:'<any empty folder>', firstMessage:'', title:'Grilling · Sample ticket 1'}), then wait 5 seconds.
checks.expected: The tab "Grilling · Sample ticket 1" after PRD with an orange dot. Clicking it shows "The agent tab is not built yet."

checks.criterion: "+" opens the screen registered as generic-agent
checks.expected: "+" highlighted and "The generic agent tab is not built yet."
The panels turn nearly opaque white, with all text still readable.
